# Rules & judging

## Hard rules (break one = disqualified)
| ID | Rule | Source (quote + location) | How we comply |
|----|------|---------------------------|---------------|
| R1 | Use the Acme Maps API | "Projects must use the Acme Maps API" — brief.pdf p.2 | src/maps.ts |
| R2 | Open-source licence | "Code must be OSI-licensed" — rules.md §4 | MIT LICENSE |

## Deliverables
| ID | Artefact | Format / limits | Due |
|----|----------|-----------------|-----|
| D1 | Public repo | GitHub URL | deadline |
| D2 | Demo video | ≤ 3 min, mp4 | deadline |

## Judging criteria
| ID | Criterion | Weight | What a top score looks like |
|----|-----------|--------|-----------------------------|
| J1 | Technical depth | ~30 % | Real traffic model, tested |
| J2 | Impact | ~25 % | Clear city use case |
| J3 | Demo | ~25 % | Live, no crashes |
| J4 | Documentation | ~20 % | One-command setup |

- Works offline for the demo
